meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把 claude-mem 里的观察记录按项目、类型、概念、文件、日期等条件筛出来，编译成一份可对话的知识库；加载后你可以就这些记录提问，追问会保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史里建一个专题知识库（比如「hooks 相关的一切」），或想追问过去的工作模式、某个主题的积累时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个只包含 hooks 相关观察的知识库
say.note: 按概念筛选记录，生成 corpus

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 这个知识库加载起来
say.note: 建立载入该知识库的 AI 会话

say.text: 这个知识库里关于 bugfix 的记录都说了什么？
say.note: 就已有知识库提问，可继续追问

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can filter your claude-mem observations by project, type, concept, files, or date, compile them into a queryable knowledge corpus, then load it into an AI session you can question, with follow-up context preserved.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build a focused knowledge base from your observation history, or ask about past work patterns or accumulated expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a corpus of only hooks-related observations
say_en.note: Runs build_corpus with a concept filter.
Runs prime_corpus to create an AI session.

say_en.text: What does this corpus say about bugfixes?
say_en.note: Runs query_corpus to answer from the corpus.
